# Pit Wall F1

> Pit Wall F1 (pitwallf1.in) is an unofficial Formula 1 fan hub for the 2026 season: championship standings, every race result, lap-by-lap replays with team radio, an interactive 3D model of every circuit built from real pole-lap telemetry, the calendar with lap records, race travel planning, and F1 games. Data comes from OpenF1 and updates automatically after every session.

Current state (after round 20 of 23, the São Paulo Grand Prix):
- World champion: Kimi Antonelli (Mercedes), 390 points; P2 Max Verstappen 279; P3 George Russell 262.
- Constructors: Mercedes 652, Ferrari 510, McLaren 404.
- Last race: São Paulo Grand Prix, won by Lando Norris.
- Next race: Las Vegas Grand Prix at Las Vegas Strip Circuit, 19–21 Nov (race start 2026-11-22T04:00:00.000Z).

## Pages
- [2026 standings](https://pitwallf1.in/formula-1-standings-2026/): drivers' and constructors' championship tables
- [2026 calendar](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-calendar-2026/): every round with dates, circuits and winners
- [Drivers](https://pitwallf1.in/drivers/) and [Teams](https://pitwallf1.in/teams/): one page each, with race-by-race results
- [Circuits](https://pitwallf1.in/circuits/): every 2026 track with length, corners, lap record, pole lap telemetry and facts
- [World champions](https://pitwallf1.in/formula-1-world-champions/): every champion since 1950
- [Next F1 race](https://pitwallf1.in/next-f1-race/): date, start time and full weekend schedule of the next Grand Prix
- [2026 results](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-results-2026/): winner, podium, pole and sprint winner of every race so far
- [2026 season review](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-2026-season-review/): how the 2026 title was won, with the points race round by round
- [2026 F1 stats](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-stats-2026/): wins, podiums, poles, fastest laps, sprint wins and DNFs for every driver and team
- [2027 calendar](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-calendar-2027/), [2027 driver line-ups](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-2027-grid/) and [2027 pre-season testing tracker](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-2027-testing/)
- [Subscribe](https://pitwallf1.in/subscribe/): the 2026 calendar as a live .ics feed (https://pitwallf1.in/f1-2026.ics) and race stories by RSS (https://pitwallf1.in/feed.xml)
- [How fast is an F1 car?](https://pitwallf1.in/how-fast-is-an-f1-car/): top speed, average speed and slowest corner at every circuit, from pole-lap telemetry
- [Learn F1](https://pitwallf1.in/learn-f1/): beginner's guide to track terms, tyres, the steering wheel and 2026 car tech (active aero, overtake mode, ERS)
- [F1 reaction test](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-reaction-test/): the five-light start, playable in the browser
- [F1 qualifying game](https://pitwallf1.in/f1-qualifying-game/): three-lap qualifying against the 2026 grid
- Race pages: https://pitwallf1.in/races/<grand-prix>-2026/ (for example https://pitwallf1.in/races/sao-paulo-grand-prix-2026/)
- Race stories: https://pitwallf1.in/races/<grand-prix>-2026/replay/ and /sprint-replay/: the race in words, a lap-by-lap position chart and tyre strategy

## Interactive app (JavaScript)
- [Race centre](https://pitwallf1.in/race-centre): every 2026 race and sprint replayed lap by lap, with timing tower, track map, race control and team radio
- [Season replay](https://pitwallf1.in/replay): the 2026 championship table animated race by race
- [Calendar](https://pitwallf1.in/calendar): live countdowns in your time zone and session replays
- [Tracks](https://pitwallf1.in/tracks): every circuit in 3D, for example https://pitwallf1.in/tracks/monza
- [Title fight](https://pitwallf1.in/title-fight): championship maths
- [Race travel](https://pitwallf1.in/travel): ticket prices and trip planner
- [Games](https://pitwallf1.in/games/reaction-test): reaction test and https://pitwallf1.in/games/qualifying
- [Learn F1](https://pitwallf1.in/learn): interactive guides, for example https://pitwallf1.in/learn/wheel (3D steering wheel)

## Data (JSON, CORS enabled, free to use with a link back)
- https://pitwallf1.in/api/index.json: list of endpoints
- https://pitwallf1.in/api/standings.json: drivers' and constructors' standings
- https://pitwallf1.in/api/calendar.json: all rounds, start times and winners
- https://pitwallf1.in/api/circuits.json: circuit facts and pole-lap stats
- https://pitwallf1.in/data/tracks/<slug>.json: circuit outline, height and pole-lap telemetry every 5 m (columns x, y, z in metres, t in seconds, speed km/h, gear, throttle %, brake)
- https://pitwallf1.in/data/index.json and https://pitwallf1.in/data/<sessionKey>.json: every session with results, laps, positions and race control
